cdsfold.reason: Makefile sets VIENNA and compiles with -I$VIENNA/include/ViennaRNA and -lRNA. README.rd asks for ViennaRNA 2.1.1. This environment has ViennaRNA 2.7.2 as a Python wheel (RNA/__init__.py and the extension module only). There is no compile-time header and no libRNA to link. CDSfold was not patched onto 2.7.2. No CDSfold number is in this file.

chisel_evaluate_note: Follow-up evaluation of the sequences already in rows. DNA Chisel mode=evaluate, no resolve_constraints and no optimize. Same specification list as the optimisation runs.

commands.lineardesign_run: cd LinearDesign && ./bin/LinearDesign_2D <lambda> 0 <codon_table.csv>  with the amino-acid sequence on stdin, terminal stop removed

lineardesign.objective: CLI lambda is multiplied by 100 in src/linear_design.cpp and used as the coefficient on log codon weight in src/Utils/network.h. Lambda 0 removes that term. Folding free energy remains in the search at every lambda. This is not usage.cai and it is not given the constraint files. Their printed CAI is log2 geometric mean over every codon in the mRNA, including Met and Trp, on the frequency table written for this run.

c_kmer12: UniquifyAllKmers(k=12, include_reverse_complement=False). canonical_strand false means a k-mer and its reverse complement are different, which is include_reverse_complement False. DNA Chisel's own docstring says the constraint may fail to resolve a k-mer that already occurs more than twice. Occurrences are counted at every start, including overlaps.

rows.objective_note: DNA Chisel MaximizeCAI via CodonOptimize(method='use_best_codon') on the ribosomal relative-adaptiveness table, zeros left as zeros. Zero floor inside DNA Chisel is 0.001; minimum positive ribosomal weight is 0.002392. Ranking matches sum of log weights only while that minimum stays above the floor: True. Reported CAI is the independent Sharp and Li mean, which excludes Met, Trp and stops. DNA Chisel's own objective score is N*log on every codon, with the floor. Seed is numpy and random seed 7, one run, unless a probe says otherwise.

cai_greedy picks the highest relative adaptiveness at each codon and breaks ties toward the lexicographically smaller codon. It does not see constraints. Under a constraint set its CAI is a floor only when the sequence is feasible; an infeasible CAI of 1 is not a feasible design.
The input CDS. Not an optimiser.
